system.prerequisites: Deception 3 ranks, Culture or Religion 1 rank
system.description:
You do not merely hide your beliefs; you understand how to wear another faith convincingly.
When using Conceal Faith to impersonate another faith or Divine Aspect, creatures familiar with that religion no longer automatically receive the normal +2-circumstance bonus to Detect Deception.
They still gain the bonus if they personally know you or possess direct evidence contradicting your assumed identity.
If you have successfully used Observe Sacred Custom concerning the faith you are impersonating within the last 24 hours, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to Conceal Faith.

Prerequisites Deception 3 ranks, Culture or Religion 1 rank

Works automatically: +1 circumstance is offered on Conceal Faith with the book's wording; the observer's lost +2 is a rule for the table.

conditionals.label: Convincing Devotion
conditionals.scope: Conceal Faith after a successful Observe Sacred Custom of the faith you impersonate within 24 hours
